name.en: AP Post Matric Scholarship: Reimbursement of Tuition Fee (RTF)

summary.en: Full fee reimbursement (tuition, special, other and exam fees, as fixed by the competent authorities)

benefit.value_note: Amount equals your course fee, so it varies

en: Non-SC students: the fee is paid to your college account. From academic year 2025-26 this is subject to FRS attendance in the college.
SC students: the fee amount continues to be released to the student's account, as per Government of India guidelines.

to_confirm: Family income limit, native/domicile rules and required documents are not in the sources checked; confirm on jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in
Application dates change every academic year; check Jnanabhumi

sources.title: G.O.Ms.No.87, Social Welfare (Edu.I) Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh, 20-11-2024 (RTF disbursement)
Post Matric Scholarship scheme description, Jnanabhumi (Social Welfare Dept, AP)
